name: Blue Spark: Spark Academy
source:
Clara joins an academy for those with special powers known as the Spark. However, little did she anticipate that she would cross paths with an old love.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
克拉拉加入了一所专门为拥有特殊能力的人开设的学院——火花学院。然而，她万万没有想到，自己会遇到旧爱。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
